race.comment: HEADBANGER (7) on top in the dash. She proved too quick over 1000m at Pakenham Synthetic second up and boasts an imposing record here with 2 wins and a placing from 3 starts. She's fast enough to land in the first few and go close. SALUTED (3) is a very consistent mare over this trip, placing in her past three since a win in town. She'll spot them a start but be rattling home. YOU'RE TWO VAIN (1) resumes. He was close up at Sandown Lakeside when in the market fresh last time in and he looked very sharp bolting in with a recent trial. SPEIR (4) was just fair fresh as favourite but was off a long break and can do much better. TENNESSEE SPIRIT (9) is flying and warrants respect again.
